shown_card_text.title: The index now answers a question
shown_card_text.what: You said it was slow, not how an index works, and you did not like the cleaner. Now a search for skill lights the Shorts row, the Shorts index opens and the skill Shorts light up, in six seconds and without the agent.
shown_card_text.why: This replaces the version you sent back this morning.
shown_card_text.question: What should happen to this animation?
shown_card_text.recommendation: Use it if the change matches your note; it is a drop-in for the version you saw.
context: Picture only; the episode or Short adds sound.
Earlier version and your answer on it are kept.

visual_input_policy: The exact first existing still/poster shown on the source card. It is one frame, not full video or audio.
